system: Classify whether this Malaysian rental conversation (English, Malay or Manglish) between a Renter and an Owner/agent is a scam or a legitimate letting. Reply only with JSON: {"label": "scam" or "legitimate", "p_scam": 0 to 1}.
decision_rule: SCAM if p_scam >= 0.5. If p_scam is missing or not a number in [0, 1], the label decides. If neither is valid, the call is an error: reported separately and excluded from the metrics.
retries: HTTP 429, 5xx and timeouts retried up to 3 times with backoff; an unparseable reply is not retried

pricing_usd_per_1M_tokens.note: gpt-4o-mini list price used for the estimate; the actual cost is computed from the usage the API returns
